source_mapping: Formal DOCX controls take precedence within their domains.
Settings and center contracts were normalized without treating prototype labels as approved canon.

values.label: Scaffold
values.definition: Structure only; no extracted claims.

values.label: Draft
values.definition: Content may exist but is not ready for controlled review.

values.label: Working
values.definition: Active extraction or reconciliation remains.

values.label: Conflict
values.definition: An unresolved material authority or candidate-value conflict affects assertions.

values.label: Blocked
values.definition: External evidence, permission, decision, rights, or safety authority prevents progress.

values.label: Review
values.definition: Content, provenance, and validation are complete; controlled approval is pending.

values.label: Approved
values.definition: Approval evidence is present and all release conditions pass.

values.label: Generated
values.definition: Reproducible derivative tied to identified upstream revisions.

values.label: Superseded
values.definition: Retained non-current authority with coherent replacement metadata.

values.label: Archived
values.definition: Retained history not active for operations.

values.label: Verified
values.definition: Confirmed by adequate authoritative evidence.

values.label: Provisional
values.definition: Supported but awaiting a defined confirmation.

values.label: Estimated
values.definition: Calculated or approximated; not a measurement.

values.label: Unverified
values.definition: Claim captured without sufficient verification.

values.label: Not Applicable
values.definition: The field does not apply to this record.

values.label: Draft
values.definition: Not ready for operational reliance.

values.label: Internal Ready
values.definition: Fit for controlled internal use only.

values.label: Venue Ready
values.definition: Fit for venue review; not necessarily public or show ready.

values.label: Public Ready
values.definition: All factual, rights, privacy, accessibility, and publication gates pass.

values.label: Show Ready
values.definition: A separate evidence-bearing checklist result; never inferred from content status.

values.label: Owned
values.definition: Ownership evidence is recorded.

values.label: Licensed
values.definition: Applicable license evidence and permitted use are recorded.

values.label: Consented
values.definition: Required consent evidence is recorded.

values.label: Needs Review
values.definition: Rights evidence or permitted scope remains incomplete.

values.label: Reference Only
values.definition: May inform work but is not cleared for publication.

values.label: Prohibited
values.definition: Use is expressly disallowed.

values.label: Expired
values.definition: Prior clearance is outside its term.

values.label: Not Reviewed
values.definition: No responsible safety review is recorded.

values.label: Needs Review
values.definition: A defined safety review remains.

values.label: Venue Review Required
values.definition: Venue-specific authority or constraints are required.

values.label: Operator Only
values.definition: Information is restricted to qualified operational users.

values.label: Cleared With Controls
values.definition: Approved controls and limitations are recorded.

values.label: Hold
values.definition: Operation must not proceed pending stated condition.

values.label: Stop
values.definition: Operation must cease under controlling authority.

values.label: Prohibited
values.definition: Operation is not permitted.

values.label: Public
values.definition: Approved for unrestricted distribution.

values.label: Internal
values.definition: Project-team information without raw private data.

values.label: Restricted
values.definition: Access-limited information such as contacts or submissions.

values.label: Safety Sensitive
values.definition: Access-limited operational safety information.

values.label: Open
values.definition: Decision remains unmade.

values.label: Under Review
values.definition: Authorized decision process is active.

values.label: Decided
values.definition: Decision and authority evidence are recorded.

values.label: Implemented
values.definition: Approved decision has been propagated and verified.

values.label: Reversed
values.definition: A later controlled decision reverses this decision.

values.label: Unknown
values.definition: No current inspection evidence.

values.label: Serviceable
values.definition: Inspection supports intended use.

values.label: Restricted Use
values.definition: Use only within recorded constraints.

values.label: Out Of Service
values.definition: Must not be used.

values.label: Repair Pending
values.definition: Corrective work remains.

values.label: Retired
values.definition: Removed permanently from active use.

values.label: Draft
values.definition: Release assembly remains editable.

values.label: In Review
values.definition: Release package is under controlled review.

values.label: Blocked
values.definition: At least one required gate cannot pass.

values.label: Approved
values.definition: Approval evidence exists; release may take effect as declared.

values.label: Published
values.definition: Approved release was distributed or deployed.

values.label: Superseded
values.definition: A newer controlled release replaces it.

values.label: Withdrawn
values.definition: Release was actively removed from use.
